objective: Stop missing profile avatar 404 storms while preserving verified avatar URLs and slow-network fallback
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only October 28 production evidence: last-90-minute Storage logs showed 470 profile-avatars info_public 400 responses versus 6 success; 536 profiles, 114 recorded avatar URLs, 118 canonical avatar.jpg objects, and zero active/verified canonical-avatar owners with a blank profile avatar_url. Signed Community Wall downloads still succeeded on Android and iPhone. Current live OTA baseline remains runtime 1.3.2; no new production OTA authorized by this PR.
acceptanceChecks: Check the real verified profile avatar URL in bounded 32-user batched RPCs before attempting any canonical Storage URL
Confirmed no-avatar users show a stable initial/fallback rather than a failed image and repeated 404s
Duplicate avatar tiles reuse the same in-flight promise and positive/negative TTL cache
Cache state isolated by signed-in viewer and bounded in size
An errored or timed-out RPC is not negatively cached; legacy URL fallback remains available
Existing explicit image URL, fallback artwork, status badge and other avatar consumers remain supported
No production database, Storage, authorization, media object or native SDK mutation
Local pure batch tests pass; TypeScript, full Integration/Performance and Android device render gates remain required
